complaint_text: The manager has sent increasingly hostile messages about noise from my unit and has threatened to change the locks and shut off the water if I do not move out.
correspondence:
2026-04-02 - Manager to Tenant: We have received noise complaints about your unit after 11pm. Please keep noise down.
2026-04-09 - Manager to Tenant: Final notice. This is your last warning.
2026-04-18 - Manager to Tenant: If you do not move out by the end of the month I will change the locks and shut off the water. People like you always cause trouble in this building.
2026-04-19 - Tenant to Manager: I am asking you to put any notice in writing through the proper process. I have contacted a lawyer.
note: Invented documents written for this project. Not a real title commitment, survey, lease, inspection report or municipal code.
